title: ChaoticMC
description: Official server for the chaoticmc network
body:
Welcome to ChaoticMC


We are an established Minecraft survival server which hosts a range of unique events, and we pride ourselves on having a strong well-rounded community! Join the server today to collaborate with friends, make huge bases and to most importantly make your mark and impact on this vast world!

We have a range of plugins to help you have fun, including claim protection and the ability to set multiple homes in case you want loads of areas! When you die, your items and XP will be saved to a grave, where you can then travel back with /back to pick up your lost gear!

Disclaimer: Not every feature on the java version will be parity with bedrock, however we work everyday to ensure that everybody no matter what platform can join ChaoticMC and have access to the same features!

Join our discord below to join the community, speak to other players or report any issues to our staff members who are happy to help!

Thank you for visiting ChaoticMC
